name: clans
author: Takaro
description: Clans: players form groups with a name and tag. Create a clan (optional currency cost), invite online players, join by invite, leave, and let leaders/officers kick members. Clan chat sends a private message to every online member. Optional shared clan bank (deposit; leader withdraws). Leaderboard ranks clans by total member playtime. All data lives in Takaro variables. Works on every game that supports private messages.

maxMembers.description: Maximum number of members per clan, leader included.

maxClans.description: Maximum number of clans on the server. 0 = no limit.

createCost.description: Currency it costs to create a clan. 0 = free. Needs the economy enabled when above 0.

nameMaxLength.description: Maximum clan name length. Names use letters, numbers and _ only.

tagMaxLength.description: Maximum clan tag length. Tags use letters, numbers and _ only.

blockedWords.description: Words that may not appear in a clan name or tag (case-insensitive).

inviteExpiryMinutes.description: How long an invite stays valid, in minutes.

enableBank.description: Enable the shared clan bank (members deposit, the leader withdraws). Needs the economy enabled.

chatFormat.description: Format of clan chat messages. Placeholders: {tag}, {player}, {message}.

listLimit.description: How many clans clan list and clan top show.

permissions.description: Allows a player to join, leave, chat in and view clans. Give this to the Player role.
Allows a player to create a clan. Give this to Player (or only VIP) together with CLANS_USE.
Allows an admin to disband any clan with clan disband <name>.

clan.description: Clan commands: create, invite, join, leave, kick, promote, demote, disband, info, list, top, chat, bank.
clan.helpText: clan create <name> <tag> | invite <player> | join <name> | leave | kick <player> | promote <player> | demote <player> | disband | info [name] | list | top | chat <message> | bank [deposit|withdraw <amount>]

arguments.name: action
arguments.helpText: What to do: create, invite, join, leave, kick, promote, demote, disband, info, list, top, chat, bank.

arguments.name: arg1
arguments.helpText: Clan name, player name, message or bank action.
